info.title: VideoraIQ Attendance Integration — On-premise
info.description:
Attendance Logs integration using an admin API key. Based on docs/attendance-api-key-integration.md; verified 15 October 2026.

**IP and port:** the default server `/api/v2` uses the same IP, protocol and API port as this Swagger page. Open this page on the backend API port, not the frontend port. Open Swagger directly on the installation you want to use; no manual server variables are needed. No domain is required.

**Authenticate:** click Authorize and paste the generated key only (without Bearer). Requests send `x-api-key`; no login JWT or access token is needed. Keys are not saved across reloads. Obtain a key from the admin UI hidden route `/admin/api-keys`.

**Permissions:** logs for attendance; people for filter options; media for snapshots. Read-only access is enough for all listed operations. The key must be active and its admin subscription must remain active. Revoked/expired keys return HTTP 401. API-key/session management cannot be accessed using an integration key.

**Summary cards:** Total Active Employees = totalEmployees; Check In = statusCounts.checkinLogs; Full Day = present; Half Day = halfDay; Absent = absent; Still In = checkedIn; Checkout = checkoutLogs. Use counts from a second request without status to keep totals unchanged while filtering table rows. Counts are not limited to the current page.

**Current date-range behavior:** notCheckedIn is roster-derived for one day (startDate, then endDate, then today), not accumulated over a range. Request each day separately for daily absence statistics. Recorded status counts are employee-day totals. minutesSpent is elapsed first check-in to last checkout, not reduced by breaks. Use returned status instead of re-grading hours.

**Timezones:** list date bounds follow the admin/shift timezone, default Asia/Kolkata; fromTime/toTime use UTC HH:mm. Roster-only and employee-detail lookups use host-local day bounds, so confirm midnight/overnight behavior when host and admin timezones differ. A timezone query does not override the admin setting.

**Errors:** inspect HTTP status and body.status; some legacy failures use HTTP 200. Limits per server process: 600 accepted requests/key/minute and 1,000 key attempts/source IP/minute. Retry 429 with backoff.

post.description:
Required key scope: logs. A read-only key is sufficient.

Filters and pagination belong in the query; employeeLocations belongs in the JSON body. skip = (page - 1) * limit. body.data.total is the filtered count before pagination. Continue until skip + attendanceLogs.length >= total. For API keys, use only one ID per nvrId/channelId/departmentIds query field; comma-separated IDs fail the key ownership guard.

status=not_checked_in returns expected employees who have no check-in, for one selected day. status=absent covers recorded absent rows only. A successful empty list may still have a nonzero roster/absence count. Summary counts ignore the name search for ordinary recorded rows. attendanceLogsStartDate is currently global earliest-record metadata; do not use it as a tenant reporting range.

200.description: Attendance rows plus roster/status totals; empty rows are a valid success.

parameters.name: export
parameters.description: Optional bypass of pagination. Omit for normal paginated list reads.

post.summary: Get an employee’s daily events and breaks
post.description:
Required key scope: logs. A read-only key is sufficient.

employeeId is attendanceLogs[i].employee._id, not the admin or application-member ID. date is YYYY-MM-DD. Each break is checkout followed by its next checkin. The initial check-in and final checkout are bookends, not breaks. No matching record returns data: [] with HTTP 200.

200.description: Successful response. Inspect body.status as legacy handlers may return failure envelopes with HTTP 200.

post.description:
Required key scope: logs. A read-only key is sufficient.

Include export=true to avoid exporting only the default page. format=excel returns CSV, not XLSX; pdf returns a PDF. Filters and employeeLocations match the list. Empty results and status=not_checked_in return HTTP 200 JSON with an explanatory message and data: [], not an empty file. Inspect Content-Type before saving a response as a report.

200.description: PDF or CSV when rows exist; JSON for no rows or unsupported roster-only export.

Content-Disposition.description: attachment; filename=AttendanceReport.pdf or AttendanceReport.csv for files

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: excel and csv produce Excel-compatible CSV.

parameters.name: export
parameters.description: Must be true to include all matching rows.

get.description: Required key scope: logs. A read-only key is sufficient. Returns defaults when no account rules have been saved. Assigned shifts can change grading context. graceHours is the open-day checkout wait, not lateness allowance.

200.description: Successful response. Inspect body.status as legacy handlers may return failure envelopes with HTTP 200.

post.description: Required key scope: people. Pagination and search for this endpoint are in the JSON body. Read department IDs from body.data.data and the count from body.data.totalCount. Do not depend on the legacy hasMore field; compare skip + data.length with totalCount.

200.description: Successful response. Inspect body.status as legacy handlers may return failure envelopes with HTTP 200.

post.description: Required key scope: people (this route belongs to authorizedChannels). Body filters are JSON arrays of owned IDs/location names. Body response data is an NVR array.

200.description: Successful response. Inspect body.status as legacy handlers may return failure envelopes with HTTP 200.

post.description: Required key scope: people. Pass nvrIds as a JSON array. Normal filter requests return a camera array; do not use the registration-specific isUserRegFilter mode for this integration.

200.description: Successful response. Inspect body.status as legacy handlers may return failure envelopes with HTTP 200.

post.description: Required key scope: people. Use locationName strings from body.data.locations in employeeLocations, not MongoDB location IDs. Some employee-derived options have no _id.

200.description: Successful response. Inspect body.status as legacy handlers may return failure envelopes with HTTP 200.

get.description: Required key scope when using an API key: media. Use an actual relative stored path from imageUrls[].images.face/person/frame or employee.profilePics. Enter the entire stored path, including slashes, as mediaPath; the backend uses a wildcard path. Do not paste an absolute URL. Storage-dependent content types and errors may vary; legacy public-media behavior is unchanged.

404.description: Stored media not found. Error format depends on storage provider.

parameters.name: mediaPath
parameters.description: Stored media path, e.g. v2/<adminId>/env/nas/images/example.jpg. Use a real path from the API response.

AdminApiKey.name: x-api-key
AdminApiKey.description: Paste the generated admin API key only. Do not prefix with Bearer and do not also send Authorization or x-access-token.

StartDate.name: startDate
StartDate.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD in the admin/shift timezone. Defaults to today; set both dates for predictable period reads.

EndDate.name: endDate
EndDate.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to the start day.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Page size. Use a reasonable positive size such as 10, 25 or 100.

Name.name: name
Name.description: Case-insensitive employee full-name search. Does not narrow ordinary-record KPI counts.

Status.name: status
Status.description: Omit for all recorded rows. present=full day; half_day=half day; checked_in=still open; absent=recorded absent only; checkin/checkout=has that event; early_leave=absent with both timestamps; no_checkout=expired open window; not_checked_in=single-day expected roster with no check-in. Last two absence filters still return status absent or not_checked_in, respectively.

NvrId.name: nvrId
NvrId.description: Optional. Leave blank to apply no filter; use a real ID from the corresponding filter-options API, never a sample ID. One NVR ID owned by this admin; comma-separated IDs fail API-key ownership validation.

ChannelId.name: channelId
ChannelId.description: Optional. Leave blank to apply no filter; use a real ID from the corresponding filter-options API, never a sample ID. One owned camera/channel ID. Use this singular parameter for API-key attendance requests.

DepartmentIds.name: departmentIds
DepartmentIds.description: Optional. Leave blank to apply no filter; use a real ID from the corresponding filter-options API, never a sample ID. Despite its plural name, use one owned department ID with API-key requests. Comma-separated strings and query arrays are not supported through the current key/handler combination.

FromTime.name: fromTime
FromTime.description: Inclusive UTC HH:mm. Example: 09:00 India time = 03:30 UTC.

employeeLocations.description: Employee-location names, full case-insensitive matches. Empty means no requested location restriction.

statusCode.description: Legacy envelope code may differ from HTTP status.
Envelope status; inspect the actual HTTP status as well.

minutesSpent.description: Rounded elapsed first check-in to last checkout; not reduced by breaks.

present.description: Full Day card; employee-day groups graded present.

earlyLeave.description: Absent recorded rows with both timestamps.

noCheckout.description: Recorded absent rows missing checkout after their grace window. May be omitted for roster-only responses.

notCheckedIn.description: Single-day expected employees with no check-in; not a cumulative range count.

checkinLogs.description: Check In card; employee-day groups with a check-in, not event count.

checkoutLogs.description: Checkout card; employee-day groups with a checkout, not event count.

Error400.description: Invalid or incomplete input. Do not send both an API key and an Authorization header.

Error401.description: API key is invalid, expired or revoked, or its owner no longer exists.

Error403.description: Missing scope/access, foreign or invalid resource reference, or inactive subscription.

Error429.description: Per-process key/IP rate limit reached. Retry with backoff; response may be plain text.

Error500.description: Server failure; malformed dates/IDs/pagination can also cause legacy handlers to return this status.
